title: Make the root Vitest gate deterministic on Windows
description: At same start/end HEAD cdc82ce2, root pnpm test produced six timeout-only failures across runner, benchmark, and pack-source plus a fatal V8 worker exit, while each affected file passed standalone immediately afterward. The root vitest.config.ts has no pool/worker bound. Diagnose and harden the root execution topology so product tests keep meaningful local time budgets and the aggregate gate becomes reproducible.
definitionOfDone: Capture host/Node/Vitest versions, root pool topology, process concurrency, start/end commit, and a red reproduction that distinguishes deterministic product failures from load-only timeouts and the V8 worker exit.
Add the smallest root-test configuration or lane split that bounds Windows resource pressure without globally inflating per-test timeouts or excluding any existing root test file.
Prove claude-launcher.windows, freeze-manifest-admission, and pack-source still execute standalone with their nonzero counts and original assertions.

Run the complete root pnpm test at least twice from unchanged delivered bytes; each run must report 364 nonzero files, 8719 nonzero tests (or explain committed roster deltas), zero timeout-only failures, and zero unhandled worker errors. Deterministic foreign failures may remain only with exact path attribution.
taskRails: Do not hide failures with retries, passWithNoTests, broad timeout inflation, or exclusions.
Preserve exact refusal-code/layer assertions and explicit shared-worktree path ownership.

implementationPlan.description: THE SMALLEST CONFIG CHANGE (DoD 2), in vitest.config.ts only. Bound the root topology explicitly; change no timeout, add no retry, no `passWithNoTests`, no exclusion (task rail 1). Import `availableParallelism` from "node:os" and set, inside `test`: `pool: "forks"` (explicit, the current default), `isolate: true` (explicit, the current default), `fileParallelism: true` (explicit), and `maxWorkers: process.env.VITEST_MAX_WORKERS === undefined ? Math.max(2, Math.min(8, Math.floor(availableParallelism() / 4))) : Number(process.env.VITEST_MAX_WORKERS)` - 8 on this 32-core host, 2 on a 4-8 core CI runner, operator-overridable. Keep `sequence.concurrent: false`, `passWithNoTests: false`, `include` unchanged. Add a 6-10 line comment stating WHY (35 roster files fork processes and 52 open SQLite temp stores; an unbounded 32-way fork pool on Windows turns CreateProcess/disk contention into load-only reds and worker exits; bounding workers is the resource cap the DoD asks for, and it is not a timeout, retry, or exclusion). Keep the file well under 60 lines. Run `pnpm exec vitest run packages/store/src/backup-generation.test.ts` once to confirm the config still loads (`Tests 40 passed`).

No timeout key, no retry, no exclusion (task rail 1 holds).

boundedWorkers(): returns Number(process.env.VITEST_MAX_WORKERS) when it is a positive integer, else Math.max(2, Math.min(8, Math.floor(availableParallelism() / 4))). Measured on this host: derived = 8 (32 CPUs / 4). A 4-8 core CI runner lands on the floor of 2.

DEVIATION FROM THE STEP TEXT, deliberate: the step spelled the override as a bare `process.env.VITEST_MAX_WORKERS === undefined ? ... : Number(...)`. That form passes NaN to vitest for `VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=""` or `=abc` (both are defined, and Number("") is 0), so a typo would silently hand the pool a garbage bound. The guarded parse fails closed onto the derived bound instead. Same intent, same 8-on-this-host result, no extra surface.

The WHY comment cites MY step-1 measurements (64 spawn-heavy files, 9 SQLite, 373 roster), not the plan's plan-time 35/52 figures which no longer match.

CONFIG-LOADS PROOF: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/store/src/backup-generation.test.ts` -> `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 40 passed (40)`, Duration 1.63s. Matches the step's expected 40.
